CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(p jsonb, p_keys text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p) is distinct from 'object' then return false; end if;
  return coalesce((select array_agg(k order by k) from jsonb_object_keys(p) k),'{}'::text[])
    = coalesce((select array_agg(k order by k) from unnest(p_keys) k),'{}'::text[]);
end $function$
